req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve an interactive Swagger UI at the endpoint GET /docs. This is a critical feature for API observability, allowing clients to explore and interact with the API. The test suite includes a positive test to ensure the Swagger UI is served correctly, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to check the response when the endpoint is accessed with an unexpected method.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_positive
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/docs")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert "Swagger UI" in response.text

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_negative
actions: Send a POST request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: Receive an HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed response.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/docs")
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with an Accept header set to application/json.
expected: The response contains JSON content indicating the Swagger UI is not available in JSON format.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/docs", headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert "Swagger UI" not in response.text
